LanguageData.PharnaStrength.label: Strength
LanguageData.PharnaStrength.description: Increases melee damage factor and carrying capacity.
LanguageData.PharnaEndurance.label: Endurance
LanguageData.PharnaEndurance.description: Increases sharp/blunt/heat armor and healing factor. Reduces damage taken and stagger duration, increases pain shock threshold, and slows rest rate fall.
LanguageData.PharnaDexterity.label: Dexterity
LanguageData.PharnaDexterity.description: Increases global work speed, shooting accuracy. Reduces melee cooldown, aiming time, and ranged cooldown.
LanguageData.PharnaAgility.label: Agility
LanguageData.PharnaAgility.description: Increases movement speed, melee dodge, and ranged dodge.
LanguageData.PharnaMana.label: Magic
LanguageData.PharnaMana.description: Increases mana conversion efficiency and maximum mana capacity.
LanguageData.PharnaWill.label: Will
LanguageData.PharnaWill.description: Increases the neural heat limit, meditation psyfocus gain, and virtue trigger chance. Reduces virtue cooldown.
LanguageData.PharnaExperience.label: Experience
LanguageData.PharnaExperience.description: Total experience gained through daily practice and learning. Each ability point gained also grants 1 experience.
LanguageData.ManaMax.label: Mana Capacity
LanguageData.ManaMax.description: Maximum mana this person can store.
LanguageData.ManaConversion.label: Mana Conversion
LanguageData.ManaConversion.description: The efficiency of converting psyfocus into mana.
LanguageData.ManaConversionSpeed.label: Mana Conversion Rate
LanguageData.ManaConversionSpeed.description: Mana converted per second when psyfocus is plentiful.
LanguageData.ManaControl.label: Mana Control
LanguageData.ManaControl.description: How precisely this person manipulates mana. Determined by spell type, Magic Arts proficiency and consciousness; affects the power of certain spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Attack.label: Mana Control - Attack
LanguageData.ManaControl_Attack.description: The mana control used when casting attack spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Heal.label: Mana Control - Heal
LanguageData.ManaControl_Heal.description: The mana control used when casting healing spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Defense.label: Mana Control - Defense
LanguageData.ManaControl_Defense.description: The mana control used when casting defense spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Buff.label: Mana Control - Buff
LanguageData.ManaControl_Buff.description: The mana control used when casting buff spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Debuff.label: Mana Control - Debuff
LanguageData.ManaControl_Debuff.description: The mana control used when casting debuff spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Enchant.label: Mana Control - Enchant
LanguageData.ManaControl_Enchant.description: The mana control used when casting enchant spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Field.label: Mana Control - Field
LanguageData.ManaControl_Field.description: The mana control used when casting field spells.
LanguageData.ManaControl_Summon.label: Mana Control - Summon
LanguageData.ManaControl_Summon.description: The mana control used when casting summon spells.
